evidence_summary: In both replay cycles the rename src->dst is rejected (http=200, code=65535, 'duplicated new collection name default:test_rename_dst ...') while only the subsequent create(dst) returns code=0, so the claimed concurrent rename+create double-success never appears in the captured HTTP.
rationale: The observed behavior contradicts the claimed observation — the 'new name must not exist' constraint is enforced at rename time — and with a single script, replay-order ambiguity, and maintainer issue 50192 declaring concurrent rename+create both-success by-design, there is no reproducible contract violation.
